# Ancient Path Ethiopia
> Premier Ethiopian Travel Agency based in Addis Ababa

Ancient Path Ethiopia offers bespoke historical expeditions, cultural journeys, and African safari tours across the Horn of Africa.

## Site Structure
- [Tours](/tours): Curated travel packages and itineraries.
- [Destinations](/destinations): Regional guides including the Danakil Depression, Omo Valley, and Northern Highlands.
- [Journal](/journal): Travel field notes, cultural histories, and travel advice.
- [Contact](/contact): Direct contact information for our Addis Ababa concierge desk.
